description: Installation of five outbuildings for a temporary period of 18 months
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The five buildings hereby approved shall have been moved to thier permitted location within within three months of the date of this permission and the sixth unauthorised temporary building shall have been removed from the site within three months of the date of the decision in accordance with the approved plans.
Condition : 2 - The five buidings herby approved shall have been removed in their entirey no later than 18 months from the date of this decision.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( ADS/GL/PCC/001, ADS/GL/PCC/002, ADS/GL/PCC/003, ADS/GL/PCC/004, ADS/GL/PCC/005, ADS/GL/PCC/006, ADS/GL/PCC/007, covering statement dated 18th January 2019 and Car Park Management Plan dated November 2018. Received: 29th January 2019 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The hereby approved five buildings shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the existing Clubhouse and Sports facilities and for no other use or purpose.
